sourcePath: sets/the-foul-realms/beta/Chaos Brawl - The Foul Realms - Beta.mse-set

cards.name: Grinder
cards.rulesText: {T}, Sacrifice a land: Add {GG}.
cards.flavorText: “The finer the grind, the stronger the magic.”

cards.name: Zigeuner-Duo
cards.rulesText: Whenever Zigeuner-Duo deals combat damage to a player, you may gain control of target artifact token that player controls.
cards.flavorText: “For a few songs: Three beers, one bottle of rum and some valuables are gone.”

cards.name: Sauna Elemental
cards.rulesText:
Prowess
Whenever you cast your second instant or sorcery spell each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on Sauna Elemental. It gains menace until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “Some say it was once a sauna guest. Others say it evolved from the steam.”

cards.name: Rotborn Colossus
cards.rulesText:
Upkeep— Sacrifice a Food. When you sacrifice a Food token this way, put two +1/+1 counters on Rotborn Colossus.
Whenever another creature dies, create a Food token.
cards.flavorText: “What happens if you throw away mutated food?”

cards.name: Igy's Astronomical Return
cards.rulesText:
Choose one or both —
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
• Return target Food card from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.flavorText: “No one returns with more style.”

cards.name: Fat Felicia
cards.rulesText:
When Fat Felicia enters, you may return target creature with power 2 or less to its owner’s hand.
Fat Felicia can’t be blocked by creatures with power 2 or less.
cards.flavorText: “She couldn’t find shells big enough for her bra. So she stopped bothering.”

cards.name: Devious Duo
cards.rulesText: Whenever one or more obsession counters are removed from a creature an opponent controls, that creature’s controller loses 1 life.
cards.flavorText: “Y’all got a couple Asian gals, too?”

cards.name: Big Ball Bluebird
cards.rulesText:
Flying
Big-Ball Bluebird has vigilance as long as you control a Location.
cards.flavorText: “Never order eggs from a Big-Ball Bluebird.”

cards.name: Austrian Slap
cards.rulesText: Austrian Slap deals 2 damage to target creature. If that creature has a Drunken counter on it, Austrian Slap deals 4 damage to it instead.
cards.flavorText: “In Austria, we call that a Knackwatschn.”

cards.name: Lecherous Patron
cards.rulesText: Whenever a Drunken counter is put on Lecherous Patron, it gets +2/+0 until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “With every drink, his standards dropped and his confidence rose.”

cards.name: Jolly Brewbelly
cards.rulesText:
Jolly Brewbelly enters with three Drunken counters on it.
Upkeep— Remove a Drunken counter from Jolly Brewbelly.
Drunken Tolerance 3
cards.flavorText: “As long as he’s drunk, he’s happy—and stays on his feet.”

cards.name: Desperate Hydrator
cards.rulesText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, draw a card, then discard a card unless you remove a Drunken counter from a creature you control.
cards.flavorText: “I’m not ruining the party. I’m making sure you survive it.”

cards.name: Puff Mama
cards.rulesText:
Menace
Whenever one or more Obsession counters are put on a creature, create a Treasure token.
cards.flavorText: “How does one make love to a siren? Come find out”

cards.name: Domina’s Devotee
cards.rulesText:
Haste
When Domina’s Devotee enters, put an Obsession counter on it.
Whenever an Obsession counter is put on Domina’s Devotee, it gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “Command me, Mistress. Please.”

cards.name: Tavern Slot Machine
cards.rulesText:
{3}, {T}: Roll a d20.
1–7 | Create a Beer token.
8–13 | Create a Food token.
14–19 | Create a Treasure token.
20 | Create a Beer token, a Food token, and a Treasure token. Then you may sacrifice Tavern Slot Machine. If you do, it deals damage to any target equal to the number of artifact tokens you control.

cards.name: Honest Laborer
cards.rulesText:
Vigilance
{T}: Create a Beer token. Activate only if you attacked this turn.
cards.flavorText: “No beer tastes better than the one after a hard day’s work.”

cards.name: Gonorrhea
cards.rulesText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +2/-2.
At the beginning of the upkeep of enchanted creature’s controller, that player loses 2 life.
cards.flavorText: “It’s driving me insane. Still worth it.”

cards.name: Ale Addict
cards.rulesText:
When Ale Addict enters, create a Beer token.
Ale Addict’s power is equal to the number of Beer tokens you control.
cards.flavorText: “You call it alcoholism. I’m just supporting the local tavern.”

cards.name: Devoted Homebody
cards.rulesText:
Defender
As long as you control a Location, Devoted Homebody can attack as though it didn’t have defender.
cards.flavorText: “Outside? On purpose?”

cards.name: Bad Drunk
cards.rulesText: As long as Bad Drunk is Drunken, it has flying.
cards.flavorText: “One beer, he’s tolerable. Two send him flying.”

cards.name: Attention Seeker
cards.rulesText: Attention Seeker gets +1/+1 for each other creature you control.
cards.flavorText: “The power of ADHD.”

cards.name: Take a Sniff
cards.rulesText: Target creature gets +1/+1 and gains hexproof until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “Snow in summer.”

cards.name: Midnight Fridge Raider
cards.rulesText: Whenever a Food you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, Midnight Fridge Raider gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “I won’t tell if you share.”

cards.name: Hitman
cards.rulesText: Upkeep {B} (At the beginning of your upkeep, you must pay {B}. If you don’t, sacrifice this permanent.)
cards.flavorText: “There’s always a way to pay. Coin is merely the preferred one.”

cards.name: Culinary Disaster
cards.rulesText: Upkeep— Lose 2 life (At the beginning of your upkeep, you must Lose 2 life. If you don’t, sacrifice this permanent.)
cards.flavorText: “Kill me”

cards.name: Still Good
cards.rulesText: Return target Food card from your graveyard to your hand. Draw a card and lose 2 life.
cards.flavorText: “Oh, extra protein!”

cards.name: Stingats Gsöchts
cards.rulesText:
Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1.
Whenever another creature dies, put a +1/+1 counter on Stingats Gsöchts.
cards.flavorText: “Des muaß so riachn.”

cards.name: Sofa Pizza
cards.rulesText: When Sofa Pizza is put into your graveyard from anywhere, until the end of your next turn, you may pay {1B}. If you do, return Sofa Pizza from your graveyard to your hand.
cards.flavorText:
“I knew I didn’t eat the whole
pizza.”

cards.name: Nagging Little Sister
cards.rulesText: As long as there is an obsessed creature on the battlefield, Nagging Little Sister has flying.
cards.flavorText: “Mad already? Perfect.”

cards.name: Manipulative Temptress
cards.rulesText: When Manipulative Temptress enters, you may move a counter from one creature to another creature.
cards.flavorText: “Dance, my darlings, dance.”

cards.name: Cold Water Coward
cards.rulesText: At the beginning of your upkeep, if Cold Water Coward isn’t Drunken, return it to its owner’s hand.
cards.flavorText: “Fuck, this water is cold!”

cards.name: Hunting Siren
cards.rulesText:
Flying
Whenever Hunting Siren attacks, another target Siren you control gets +1/+1 and gains flying until end of turn.
cards.flavorText: “Special delivery!”

cards.name: Canonball Carl
cards.rulesText:
Flash
When Canonball Carl enters, return another target creature to its owner’s hand.
cards.flavorText: “Beidlbombe!.”

cards.name: Barmaid
cards.rulesText: When Barmaid enters, if you control an artifact token, put an Obsession counter on target creature an opponent controls. (A creature with one or more Obsession counters on it attacks each combat if able. Whenever a creature with one or more Obsession counters on it attacks, remove an Obsession counter from it.)

cards.name: Coastal Watchman
cards.rulesText: Whenever one or more obsessed creatures attack, untap target creature you control.
cards.flavorText: “Even Sirens can get obsessed sometimes.”

cards.name: Not Invited
cards.rulesText: Counter target creature or planeswalker spell.
cards.flavorText: “Why didn’t you guys say anything?”

cards.name: Information Broker
cards.rulesText: Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, you may pay {1U}. If you do, draw a card.
cards.flavorText: “I know a guy who knows a guy.”

cards.name: Copycat
cards.rulesText: Whenever one or more counters are put on another creature you control, you may put the same number and kinds of counters on Copycat.
cards.flavorText: “Shut up!”-”Shut up!”-”No, you shut up!”

cards.name: Blightpear Ancient
cards.rulesText:
Defender, reach
Exhaust — {2GG}: Create two Food tokens. (Activate each exhaust ability only once.)
cards.flavorText: “The tree becoming sentient was concerning. The increased pear yield made it acceptable.”

cards.name: Overstimulated Flora
cards.rulesText:
Upkeep {1G} (At the beginning of your upkeep, you must pay {1G}. If you don’t, sacrifice this permanent.)
Whenever you pay Overstimulated Flora’s upkeep cost, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
cards.flavorText: “The fertilizer promised stronger growth. Didn’t expect that.”

cards.name: Ravenous Trollkin
cards.rulesText: Upkeep {G} (At the beginning of your upkeep, you must pay {G}. If you don’t, sacrifice this permanent.)
cards.flavorText: “That was supposed to feed us for the whole week.”

cards.name: Exasperated Patriarch
cards.rulesText: Reach, trample
cards.flavorText: “They told him about the joys of fatherhood. Somehow, the other parts never came up.”

cards.name: The Stoned Peaks
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {R} or {G} to your mana pool.)
As The Stoned Peaks enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, The Stoned Peaks enters the battlefield tapped.

cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {G} or {W} to your mana pool.)
As Hopsfield Vale enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Hopsfield Vale enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “Where lush fields of hops dance in the breeze, painting a picture of dreams in the morning fog.”

cards.name: Sacred Brewery
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {R} or {W} to your mana pool.)
As Sacred Brewery enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Sacred Brewery enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “The foundation of the brewing art, where sacred kegs are born to cradle liquid joy.”

cards.name: Decaying Orchard
cards.rulesText:
({T}: Add {B} or {G} to your mana pool.)
As Decaying Orchard enters the battlefield, you may pay 2 life. If you don’t, Decaying Orchard enters the battlefield tapped.
cards.flavorText: “An orchard abandoned, where the sweet scent of pears has faded, leaving only the sorrow of neglect.”
